auto-reload instead of showing a cryptic error.

Fix workspace switcher display when sidebar is collapsed

Problem: When sidebar was collapsed, workspace dropdown didn't show
because of overflow clipping issues.

Solution: Use React Portal with fixed positioning
- Dropdown now renders directly in document.body via createPortal
- Positioned using getBoundingClientRect() for accurate placement
- Expanded sidebar: dropdown above button, spanning full width
- Collapsed sidebar: dropdown to the right of button, 224px width
